Assisted by Deepseek Flash v4.1

This PR adds a small registry: a VideoEncoder protocol, register_video_encoder(), and an entry-point group (sglang.video_encoders) so a package can publish a backend without patching SGLang. The stage takes an optional encoder_name and resolves it through open_video_encoder(); None keeps the built-in default, so behaviour is unchanged for existing callers, including the None-means-fall-back-to-host-save contract when the encoder cannot handle the output.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Registry for the video encoders that consume frames while a decode is running.
+
+:class:`EncodeWhileDecoding` forwards each run of finished frames to an encoder
+resolved from this registry:
+
+* :class:`VideoEncoder` is the protocol an encoder implements.
+* :func:`register_video_encoder` adds a factory under a name.
+* entry points published in the ``sglang.video_encoders`` group are registered on
+  first lookup, so a package can supply an encoder without patching SGLang.
+* :func:`set_default_video_encoder` selects the encoder used when a caller does
+  not name one; :data:`DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER` is the built-in ffmpeg encoder.
+
+A factory receives the keyword arguments the stage has (``save_file_path``,
+``device``, ``height``, ``width``, ``fps``, ``num_frames``, and the audio and
+compression settings) and returns an encoder, or ``None`` when the output cannot
+use that path, in which case the stage saves the frames after the decode instead.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import threading
+from importlib.metadata import entry_points
+from typing import Any, Callable, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable
+
+import torch
+
+#: Entry-point group discovery looks at.
+VIDEO_ENCODER_ENTRY_POINT_GROUP = "sglang.video_encoders"
+
+#: Name used when the caller does not ask for a specific encoder. The built-in
+#: encoder shells out to ffmpeg (libx264) and stages frames through CUDA-registered
+#: host memory, so the name describes the process, not a hardware encoder.
+DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER = "ffmpeg"
+
+
+@runtime_checkable
+class VideoEncoder(Protocol):
+    """Encodes the frames a decode produces, as it produces them.
+
+    ``write`` is called once per run of finished frames, so one clip arrives as a
+    sequence of calls whose ``T`` varies; concatenating the arguments in call
+    order reproduces the clip in decode order. Each call carries a ``[3, T, H, W]``
+    float tensor in ``[0, 1]`` on the device that produced it, and the producer
+    does not synchronise first: an implementation that copies to the host must do
+    so on the producing device's current stream.
+
+    One encoder serves one clip. A caller encoding several clips creates one
+    encoder per clip.
+
+    ``close`` returns the path written, or ``None`` when the encoder wrote the
+    path it was opened with. The stage reports exactly one path per clip, so an
+    encoder that produces several files must return the one that represents the
+    clip.
+    """
+
+    def write(self, frames: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Queue frames for encoding. Must not block the producing stream."""
+
+    def close(self) -> str | None:
+        """Finish writing.
+
+        Return the path actually written when it differs from the one the caller
+        asked for, or ``None`` to mean "the path you passed to the factory is the
+        output" (what the built-in encoder does). One path per request: the
+        pipeline requires ``len(output_file_paths) == len(requests)``.
+        """
+
+    def abort(self) -> None:
+        """Discard any partial output. Safe to call after ``close``."""
+
+
+VideoEncoderFactory = Callable[..., Optional[VideoEncoder]]
+
+_REGISTRY: dict[str, VideoEncoderFactory] = {}
+#: Set by ``set_default_video_encoder``; ``None`` means DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER.
+_DEFAULT_OVERRIDE: str | None = None
+_REGISTRY_LOCK = threading.Lock()
+_ENTRY_POINTS_LOADED = False
+
+
+def _default_factory() -> VideoEncoderFactory:
+    def open_default(**kwargs: Any) -> Optional[VideoEncoder]:
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.entrypoints.utils import CudaVideoEncoder
+
+        return CudaVideoEncoder.open(**kwargs)
+
+    return open_default
+
+
+def _load_entry_points() -> None:
+    """Register encoders advertised by installed packages. Runs once."""
+    global _ENTRY_POINTS_LOADED
+    if _ENTRY_POINTS_LOADED:
+        return
+    _ENTRY_POINTS_LOADED = True
+    try:
+        discovered = entry_points(group=VIDEO_ENCODER_ENTRY_POINT_GROUP)
+    except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - defensive, older importlib
+        return
+    for entry_point in discovered:
+        try:
+            _REGISTRY.setdefault(entry_point.name, entry_point.load())
+        except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - a broken plugin must not break import
+            continue
+
+
+def register_video_encoder(
+    name: str, factory: VideoEncoderFactory, *, replace: bool = False
+) -> None:
+    """Install ``factory`` under ``name``.
+
+    ``replace=False`` keeps an already registered encoder, so a plugin cannot
+    silently shadow a built-in one.
+    """
+    if not name:
+        raise ValueError("video encoder name must be non-empty")
+    with _REGISTRY_LOCK:
+        if name in _REGISTRY and not replace:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"video encoder {name!r} is already registered; "
+                "pass replace=True to override it"
+            )
+        _REGISTRY[name] = factory
+
+
+def set_default_video_encoder(name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Choose the encoder used when a caller does not name one.
+
+    This is the selection point for embedders: there is no per-request argument,
+    because the pipeline writes exactly one file per request. Passing ``None``
+    restores the built-in default.
+    """
+    global _DEFAULT_OVERRIDE
+    if name is None:
+        _DEFAULT_OVERRIDE = None
+        return
+    get_video_encoder_factory(name)  # validates, raises for unknown names
+    _DEFAULT_OVERRIDE = name
+
+
+def default_video_encoder() -> str:
+    """The name ``open_video_encoder(None, ...)`` resolves to."""
+    return _DEFAULT_OVERRIDE or DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER
+
+
+def available_video_encoders() -> list[str]:
+    with _REGISTRY_LOCK:
+        _load_entry_points()
+        return sorted(_REGISTRY)
+
+
+def get_video_encoder_factory(name: str | None = None) -> VideoEncoderFactory:
+    """Resolve ``name`` (default: :data:`DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER`) to a factory."""
+    resolved_name = name or default_video_encoder()
+    with _REGISTRY_LOCK:
+        _load_entry_points()
+        factory = _REGISTRY.get(resolved_name)
+    if factory is not None:
+        return factory
+    if resolved_name == DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER:
+        return _default_factory()
+    raise ValueError(
+        f"unknown video encoder {resolved_name!r}; "
+        f"available: {', '.join(available_video_encoders() + [DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER])}"
+    )
+
+
+def open_video_encoder(
+    name: str | None = None, **kwargs: Any
+) -> Optional[VideoEncoder]:
+    """Build the encoder for ``name``, or ``None`` if it cannot handle this output."""
+    return get_video_encoder_factory(name)(**kwargs)

@@ -0,0 +1,282 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""The video-encoder registry is the seam ``EncodeWhileDecoding`` resolves through."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages import video_encoders as ve
+
+
+class _Recorder:
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        self.kwargs = kwargs
+        self.written = []
+        self.closed = False
+
+    def write(self, frames):
+        self.written.append(frames)
+
+    def close(self):
+        self.closed = True
+        return ["/tmp/out.mp4"]
+
+    def abort(self):
+        pass
+
+
+def test_default_name_resolves_to_builtin(monkeypatch):
+    """No name means the built-in encoder, i.e. today's behaviour."""
+    seen = {}
+
+    def fake_open(**kwargs):
+        seen.update(kwargs)
+        return _Recorder(**kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ve, "_default_factory", lambda: fake_open)
+    encoder = ve.open_video_encoder(
+        None, save_file_path="/tmp/x.mp4", height=64, width=64
+    )
+    assert isinstance(encoder, _Recorder)
+    assert seen["save_file_path"] == "/tmp/x.mp4"
+    assert ve.get_video_encoder_factory(None) is fake_open
+
+
+def test_registered_encoder_is_selected_by_name():
+    ve.register_video_encoder("recorder-test", _Recorder, replace=True)
+    encoder = ve.open_video_encoder("recorder-test", save_file_path="/tmp/y.mp4")
+    assert isinstance(encoder, _Recorder)
+    assert "recorder-test" in ve.available_video_encoders()
+
+
+def test_unknown_name_names_the_alternatives():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as error:
+        ve.open_video_encoder("no-such-encoder")
+    assert "no-such-encoder" in str(error.value)
+    assert "ffmpeg" in str(error.value)
+
+
+def test_registration_does_not_shadow_by_default():
+    ve.register_video_encoder("dup-test", _Recorder, replace=True)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        ve.register_video_encoder("dup-test", _Recorder)
+    ve.register_video_encoder("dup-test", _Recorder, replace=True)
+
+
+def test_builtin_encoder_satisfies_the_protocol():
+    """The default encoder must actually conform, not just be adapted into place."""
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.entrypoints.utils import CudaVideoEncoder
+
+    for method in ("write", "close", "abort"):
+        assert callable(getattr(CudaVideoEncoder, method)), method
+
+
+def test_protocol_matches_the_builtin_signatures():
+    """close() takes no arguments and returns nothing, as the built-in does."""
+    import inspect
+
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.entrypoints.utils import CudaVideoEncoder
+
+    for method in ("write", "close", "abort"):
+        builtin = inspect.signature(getattr(CudaVideoEncoder, method))
+        declared = inspect.signature(getattr(ve.VideoEncoder, method))
+        assert list(builtin.parameters) == list(declared.parameters), method
+
+
+def test_finish_reports_a_different_path_once(monkeypatch):
+    """An encoder may write elsewhere, but exactly one path per request."""
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages import (
+        encode_while_decoding as ewd,
+    )
+
+    class _Elsewhere:
+        def write(self, frames):
+            pass
+
+        def close(self):
+            return "/tmp/actually-written.mp4"
+
+        def abort(self):
+            pass
+
+    stage = object.__new__(ewd.EncodeWhileDecoding)
+    stage._encoder = _Elsewhere()
+    stage._failed = False
+    stage._writes_file = True
+    stage.save_file_path = "/tmp/asked-for.mp4"
+    stage._batch = type("B", (), {})()
+    assert stage.finish() == ["/tmp/actually-written.mp4"]
+
+
+def test_finish_falls_back_to_the_opened_path(monkeypatch):
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages import (
+        encode_while_decoding as ewd,
+    )
+
+    class _Builtin:
+        def write(self, frames):
+            pass
+
+        def close(self):
+            return None
+
+        def abort(self):
+            pass
+
+    stage = object.__new__(ewd.EncodeWhileDecoding)
+    stage._encoder = _Builtin()
+    stage._failed = False
+    stage._writes_file = True
+    stage.save_file_path = "/tmp/asked-for.mp4"
+    stage._batch = type("B", (), {})()
+    assert stage.finish() == ["/tmp/asked-for.mp4"]
+
+
+def test_default_encoder_can_be_chosen_without_a_server_arg():
+    ve.register_video_encoder("alternative", _Recorder, replace=True)
+    ve.set_default_video_encoder("alternative")
+    try:
+        assert ve.default_video_encoder() == "alternative"
+        assert ve.get_video_encoder_factory(None) is _Recorder
+    finally:
+        ve.set_default_video_encoder(None)
+    assert ve.default_video_encoder() == ve.DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER
+
+
+def test_choosing_an_unknown_default_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        ve.set_default_video_encoder("does-not-exist")
+    assert ve.default_video_encoder() == ve.DEFAULT_VIDEO_ENCODER
+
+
+def test_stage_opens_the_configured_encoder():
+    """The configured default is what the stage opens, with no server arg involved."""
+    import torch
+
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages import (
+        encode_while_decoding as ewd,
+    )
+
+    seen = {}
+
+    class _Spy:
+        def write(self, frames):
+            pass
+
+        def close(self):
+            return None
+
+        def abort(self):
+            pass
+
+    def factory(**kwargs):
+        seen.update(kwargs)
+        return _Spy()
+
+    ve.register_video_encoder("spy-open", factory, replace=True)
+    ve.set_default_video_encoder("spy-open")
+    try:
+        stage = object.__new__(ewd.EncodeWhileDecoding)
+        stage.save_file_path = "/tmp/spy.mp4"
+        stage._batch = type(
+            "B",
+            (),
+            {
+                "fps": 24,
+                "num_frames": 4,
+                "output_compression": None,
+                "x264_preset": None,
+            },
+        )()
+        stage._audio = None
+        stage._audio_sample_rate = None
+        stage._encoder = None
+        stage._failed = False
+        stage._writes_file = True
+
+        stage._encoder = stage._open(torch.zeros(3, 4, 16, 16))
+        assert seen["save_file_path"] == "/tmp/spy.mp4"
+        assert seen["fps"] == 24
+        assert seen["width"] == 16 and seen["height"] == 16
+    finally:
+        ve.set_default_video_encoder(None)
+
+
+def test_multiple_chunks_arrive_as_frame_runs():
+    """write() is called once per finished run, each [3, T, H, W]."""
+    import torch
+
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages import (
+        encode_while_decoding as ewd,
+    )
+
+    class _Recorder:
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.chunks = []
+
+        def write(self, frames):
+            self.chunks.append(frames)
+
+        def close(self):
+            return None
+
+        def abort(self):
+            pass
+
+    encoder = _Recorder()
+    stage = object.__new__(ewd.EncodeWhileDecoding)
+    stage._batch = type(
+        "B",
+        (),
+        {
+            "fps": 24,
+            "num_frames": 9,
+            "output_compression": None,
+            "x264_preset": None,
+            "extra": {},
+        },
+    )()
+    stage._finish_frames = None
+    stage._audio = None
+    stage._audio_sample_rate = None
+    stage._encoder = encoder
+    stage._failed = False
+    stage._writes_file = True
+    stage.save_file_path = "/tmp/chunks.mp4"
+
+    stage(torch.zeros(1, 3, 9, 16, 16))
+
+    assert len(encoder.chunks) >= 1
+    for chunk in encoder.chunks:
+        assert chunk.shape[0] == 3, "each write is [3, T, H, W]"
+        assert chunk.shape[-2:] == (16, 16)
+    assert sum(c.shape[1] for c in encoder.chunks) == 9
+
+
+def test_builtin_receives_the_compression_settings(monkeypatch):
+    """The default factory must forward x264_preset and output_compression."""
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.entrypoints import utils as entry_utils
+
+    seen = {}
+
+    def fake_open(**kwargs):
+        seen.update(kwargs)
+        return _Recorder()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(entry_utils.CudaVideoEncoder, "open", staticmethod(fake_open))
+
+    factory = ve.get_video_encoder_factory(None)
+    factory(
+        save_file_path="/tmp/x.mp4",
+        device="cuda:0",
+        height=320,
+        width=480,
+        fps=24,
+        num_frames=25,
+        output_compression=19,
+        x264_preset="ultrafast",
+        max_queued_frames=17,
+    )
+
+    assert seen["x264_preset"] == "ultrafast"
+    assert seen["output_compression"] == 19
+    assert seen["num_frames"] == 25
+    assert seen["max_queued_frames"] == 17
